about: Every asset Scandinavian Flick ships, where it comes from and under what licence. The game ships no audio file, no font file and no model or texture file: every sound is synthesized and every car, tree, building and road is geometry built by code at run time. Nothing here is third-party. A new kind of asset, or a new generator, changes this file in the same commit.
